role: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer (Atherton Tablelands, Far North QLD)
subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello RCG recruitment team,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your Working at RCG page invites people to email this address, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge engineer. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation.

Your road rehabilitation and highway safety work for Main Roads is close to the road and pavement design I studied, and your careers page quotes an engineer who started with RCG as a site engineer in 2019. My site experience is under a year and none of it is in Australia yet, so the training you offer matters to me.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate site engineer opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer
paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Robinson Civil Group has room for a graduate site engineer. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised role, sent to the recruitment address on your Working at RCG page.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

Your projects page lists road rehabilitation on the Millaa Millaa to Malanda Road and road safety packages on the Kennedy and Palmerston Highways for the Department of Transport and Main Roads. That road work is where I want to build my career. My site experience is under a year and was not in Australia, and I have not yet worked to TMR specifications, so I would value the training and supervision your careers page describes.

I am based in Melton VIC and hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, with full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation. My resume is attached and study drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering my enquiry.

notes: SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY. SEEK sweeps at 3, 7 and 14 days (60, 60 then 80 details, digest up to 40) plus the Victoria off-SEEK rotation found no new junior adverts that cleared screening (19 never-screened adverts, all agency, 3+ years, TMR experience, student-only or experienced roles; every Victorian off-SEEK find was already on the tracker), so this is the runbook's one speculative enquiry. RCG careers page read 13 Oct 2026 AEDT shows no engineering vacancy and invites applications by email to recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au. Relocation to Far North Queensland is not promised; Marc to confirm before any interview.
